headline: The most snow is likely on day 3: about 1 in at the mid-mountain gauge (range 0 to 6), from 0.06 in of water.

points.text: Wind aloft from the northwest at 11 mph (weak flow flow). Mid-mountain about 28 F, base about 33 F. Moisture: 5 mm of water in the column, 36% humidity near ridge level.
Wind aloft from the north-northwest at 21 mph (northwest flow). Mid-mountain about 27 F, base about 35 F. Moisture: 4 mm of water in the column, 36% humidity near ridge level.

Wind aloft from the west-northwest at 37 mph (west flow). Mid-mountain about 26 F, base about 35 F. Snow quality: light (about 18 in of snow per inch of water). Ridge winds near 18 mph from the west-southwest will load east-northeast-facing slopes just below the ridges heavily.
